messages.author: amara.vandermeer.100043@quincewickcreamery.example
messages.text: Thanks everyone for joining this emergency space as we figure out how to handle the spring conference cancellations and member refunds.

messages.author: lucia.ochoa.102089@umberfendairysystems.example
messages.text: ICF staff is compiling the list of affected producers right now so we can process credit requests without stalling cash flow for smaller farmsteads.

messages.author: tom.reyes.000109@speltmoorfarmstead.example
messages.text: Appreciate the quick work on this. We are seeing farmers markets drop off completely in our region, so online ordering is our only channel left.

messages.author: henri.dubois.000107@lakemail.example
messages.text: Same situation across the Atlantic. We need to pivot our technical workshops to video formats as soon as possible so apprentices do not lose the season.

messages.author: amara.vandermeer.100043@quincewickcreamery.example
messages.text: Marcus and Henri have agreed to draft the curriculum for the virtual affineur series. Let us review their draft outline by next Tuesday.

messages.author: damien.marceau.100153@mailhaven.example
messages.text: The modules are structured now. We kept them modular so makers can watch around their modified milk pickup schedules.

messages.author: lucia.ochoa.102089@umberfendairysystems.example
messages.text: Registration for the first online grading session opened this morning, and the initial slots filled up within twenty minutes.

messages.author: astrid.ravn.102376@homestead.example
messages.text: Down here in the southern hemisphere we are adapting the same online modules for our spring intake. Thanks for making the materials so flexible.

messages.author: maren.bergeron.101067@quillpost.example
messages.text: Distributors are finally asking for digital spec sheets instead of paper packets, so our timing on these digital upgrades was fortuitous.

messages.author: amara.vandermeer.100043@quincewickcreamery.example
messages.text: With the online courses running smoothly and the refund backlog cleared, we should start drafting our final report for the board.

messages.author: lucia.ochoa.102089@umberfendairysystems.example
messages.text: I have put together the summary of emergency funds disbursed and course attendance numbers for the year-end packet.

messages.author: amara.vandermeer.100043@quincewickcreamery.example
messages.text: Thank you all for the tremendous effort this year under very difficult conditions. I am closing this task force space as our mandate is now complete.
